svg.desc: Diagram of Spoolwarden showing the Hub at the centre (Hub service, Spoolman, Slicer presets, and Web access) connected to the App on Android, Web app, Hub page, CLI, Slicer Sync, Home Assistant, Label Reader, Weigh Station, Tag Reader, Bambu Lab printers, and Klipper printers.
